stories.title: Token Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define bearer token structure, metadata (issued_at, expires_at, scope, issuer), and validation contract aligned with existing auth.py behavior.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Core Logic (Issuance, Rotation, Expiration)
stories.description: Implement core logic for issuing tokens, enforcing expiration, and rotating tokens based on TTL policies consistent with current validation flow.

stories.title: Bearer Token Validation Middleware
stories.description: Implement middleware/service layer to enforce token validation on incoming requests, including rejection of expired or malformed tokens.

stories.title: Protected Endpoint Integration (GPTReader and Pipelines)
stories.description: Integrate token validation middleware into GPTReader and Azure Function pipeline endpoints to enforce authentication consistently across all protected services.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create tests covering token issuance, expiration handling, rotation behavior, and validation failures, including integration tests with GPTReader endpoints.
